findings.summary: summarize() iterates the one-shot generator returned by read_rows twice (any() pre-check then a for loop), so rows up to and including the first high-severity row are dropped, giving wrong total/by_actor/high values and a false 'No high-severity audit events' report.
Parse errors now surface mid-iteration rather than at the read_rows() call, so callers wrapping only the call in try/except would no longer catch them (reviewer found no such callers).
test_read_rows_is_lazy does not close the generator, leaving the file handle open until garbage collection (harmless in CPython).
